# New World Encyclopedia

> A comprehensive, peer-reviewed online encyclopedia covering philosophy, ancient history, game theory, Native American cultures, and scientific concepts with an emphasis on balanced, well-researched content.

New World Encyclopedia provides freely accessible, high-quality encyclopedia entries across humanities, sciences, and cultural studies. The site emphasizes editorial rigor through copyediting and peer review, making it a reliable reference resource for students, researchers, and general knowledge seekers.

## Key Topics

- Game theory
- Ancient Greek philosophy
- Atomism
- Pre-Socratic philosophers
- Democritus
- Prisoner's dilemma
- Philosophy
- Ontology
- Pueblo peoples
- Ancient Pueblo Peoples
- Atoms and atomic theory
- Nash equilibrium
- Materialism
- Arizona
- Ancestral Pueblo architecture

## Getting Started

- [Research Begins Here](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Info:Main_Page): Main encyclopedia homepage featuring philosophy and game theory articles
- [Project Vision](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Info:Project_Vision): Project vision and editorial philosophy of New World Encyclopedia
- [Copyedited Articles Directory](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Category:Copyedited): Directory of copyedited articles organized by category for browsing

## Philosophy & History of Ideas

- [Philosophy](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Philosopher): Comprehensive overview of philosophy history and traditions
- [Pre-Socratic Philosophy](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Pre-Socratic_philosophy): Overview of Pre-Socratic philosophy and early Western philosophers
- [Ontology](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Ontology): Encyclopedia entry on ontology and metaphysics philosophy
- [Atomism](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Atomism): Encyclopedia entry on atomism philosophy and physical science
- [Democritus](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Democritus): Biography of ancient Greek philosopher Democritus and atomism theory
- [Leucippus](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Leucippus): Entry on Pre-Socratic philosopher Leucippus and atomism theory

## Game Theory & Strategic Analysis

- [Game Theory](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Game_theory): Comprehensive encyclopedia entry on game theory and strategic analysis
- [Prisoner's Dilemma](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Prisoner%27s_dilemma): Encyclopedia entry on Prisoner's Dilemma game theory concept

## Science & Natural Philosophy

- [Atom](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Atom): Encyclopedia entry on atom structure and atomic theory
- [Cosmos](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Cosmos): Definition and etymology of cosmos with botanical references
- [Phototropism](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Phototropism): Encyclopedia entry on phototropism and plant light response

## Native American Cultures & History

- [Pueblo People](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Pueblo_people): Encyclopedia entry on Pueblo people and Native American culture
- [Ancient Pueblo Peoples](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Ancient_Pueblo_Peoples): Encyclopedia entry on Ancient Pueblo Peoples and Anasazi culture
- [Cliff Dwellings](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Cliff_dwelling): Entry on cliff dwellings and Ancestral Pueblo architecture
- [Arizona](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Arizona): Encyclopedia entry on Arizona state geography and demographics

## Optional Features

- [Did You Know](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Info:Did_you_know): Trivia and interesting facts feature for encyclopedia engagement
